text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...All right, no dizziness either.
I'm good to go now.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(And all I did was push myself just a tiny bit,
too.
...Oh well!
Time to dial the workload back again—)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Heeeeeeeey, Flight————!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the other dayyyy!
You helped me level up so much!
I won the categorized meet,
and my debut's officially locked innnnn!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm just so happy,
I'm...
*sniff* I'm so freakin' happyyyy...!
Waaaahhhhh, thank you, everyoneeeeee!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(I see, Ticket-san... is making her debut.
With such wonderful raw materials,
she's destined for greatness.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...When that time comes...
will I still just be watching from the
sidelines?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, just kidding!
Come on, Fu-chan,
dress yourself in positivity. It's okay,
because I have—
choice_data_list: —Because you have brilliant materi...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Trainer...
...Oh,
sorry about making you worry the other day.
But I'm already—
choice_data_list: It's going to be okay. Absolutely ...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: I went to see your "Big Sister."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ! But why...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After North Flight collapsed...
I visited the youth training club she used
to attend,
told her "Big Sister" how I felt,
and asked for her guidance—

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for trying to help that girl.
I can no longer stay right by her side,
after all.
choice_data_list: I'm not sure what I can do just ye...

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
...She truly is a strong girl.
She always tells me,
"It's all thanks to you"...
but all I ever did was share knowledge.

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
She was the one who chose to look forward,
the one who refused to give up.
Do you know what Fu-chan's "aesthetic" is?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Never lament who "I" am.
Love the "me" that was born into this
world.
And dress "myself" up in the way that makes
"me" shine the brightest.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Lamenting your material won't pave a path
forward.
Refusing to love it won't let you escape
being "yourself."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Staring into the mirror and letting out
sighs...
won't change a single thing.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Find the coordination that makes your raw
material shine at its absolute best.
All so that you can fall completely in love
with "who you are"—

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to do something for her,
believing in her...
that faith alone will surely give her
strength.

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
I know you are...
the perfect trainer for Fu-chan.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Big Sis.
choice_data_list: Let me help you run at full throttle.
Please let me help you give it you...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Are you sure about that?
There's no telling if a day like that will
ever even come.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
With a constitution like mine,
every teacher and trainer told me...
even if I managed to debut,
finding real success would be out of
reach.
choice_data_list: It's precisely because of that con...
That very constitution is what wil...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because of her delicate constitution,
she put in tremendous thought to grow.
With her natural speed and sharp intellect...
her potential is limitless.
choice_data_list: You can shine to the fullest... No...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
I—I believe so too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From that day on,
our journey of trial and error began—
all so North Flight could finally "run with
everything she had."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —Focusing primarily on the mile, you say?
choice_data_list: Yeah.
That's right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While she possessed the talent to conquer
three distances,
her current physical condition couldn't
sustain it.
So, for the time being—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We took longer medium distances off the
priority list and narrowed our focus to
shorter routes. Even then,
rather than sprints that require maintaining
top speed the entire way—
choice_data_list: The mile is the perfect outfit tai...
The mile is the exact coordination...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Anchoring around the mile allows for strategic
breathers... The core of her coordination
was clearly distinguishing between sprinting
and miling within the short-distance
category.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. That's...
exactly what I was thinking too.
Then let's train with that plan in mind!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Between supervising her workouts,
I studied her childhood records borrowed
from her "Big Sister,"
even digging into medical texts to expand
my knowledge.
choice_data_list: (My conditioning and care for her ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And alongside all that,
I kept fashion magazines at hand.
I wanted to understand what she loved and
make sure her mental care was just as
thorough.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—*Pant*... *gasp*...
Huh? Are we taking our break over here
today?
This isn't our usual route, is it?
choice_data_list: I heard there's a flea market goin...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ! ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tried to steer her toward a change of pace
as naturally as possible...
but judging by her look,
she saw right through my intentions from
the start.
choice_data_list: ...Want to go take a look?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, hehe... Ahaha.
All right,
let's go hunt for some hidden treasures♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bit by bit,
North Flight and I steadily made our
preparations...
until one day, after some time had passed.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
choice_data_list: This is the distance you can run a...
This is the exact distance where y...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Evaluating our training and logs up to this
point...
the number we arrived at was the final 200
meters—that was it.
choice_data_list: Anything more is too much, for now.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
..."For now," right? Understood!
Here I go!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: *Pant*... *gasp*... *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(—Whenever I run,
my legs always itch to go faster.
I want to accelerate more, push further.
I know I can do it... but...)
choice_data_list: (Not yet, Flight... not just yet—)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(—It's all right.
Enduring is what I do best...
Once I hit that final stretch...—)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(I still have a whole 200 meters "left."
More than enough to reveal my true
brilliance!)
choice_data_list: —Now!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ngh!!
Yaaaahhhhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the next instant,
North Flight displayed a blinding flash of
speed—
I will never forget that velocity,
as if she were taking flight into the sky.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... haaah... wheeze... ngh.
Phew... *sigh*... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Hehehe... giggle.
Phew...
choice_data_list: Flight...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I...—
choice_data_list: Running with everything you've got...
Running with everything you've got...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
!
...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I still have a mountain of challenges to
overcome. But... giving it my all,
even for a moment,
gave me hope. I believe in myself!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—I want to drape myself in an unprecedented,
radiant brilliance.
To do that,
I need the discerning eye of someone I can
trust.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I'll cause you plenty of trouble.
But... will you continue
to coordinate me into something wonderful
from here on out?
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The road ahead might hold hardships far
beyond what we imagine. But,
I swear I'll make North Flight's raw material—
her true potential...
shine brighter than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufu... Ahahahahaha!!
I saw that, Miss Flight! With my very own wide,
sparkling eyes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That truly bakushin-level speed...
You truly are my destined rival!
Let us decide who is the ultimate bakushin
in the Twinkle Series!
